guard_streams.source: Telecoms price rises – what are your rights?

facts.detail: Ofcom last updated its telecoms price-rises guidance on 29 June 2026.
Since January 2025, new contracts cannot contain inflation-linked or percentage-based in-contract price rises.
Any specified in-contract price rise must be expressed clearly in pounds and pence before sign-up.
Price-rise information must be displayed prominently and transparently before a customer signs up.
Providers must state when any change to the monthly price will occur.

guard_streams.source: Checklist for new phone or broadband contract

facts.detail: Ofcom last updated the new-contract checklist on 26 June 2026.
The checklist applies to residential customers and small businesses with ten employees or fewer.
The guidance notes that contracts may be rolling or use fixed periods such as 12, 18 or 24 months.
Providers must offer at least one contract option no longer than 12 months for each service.
A residential or small-business service contract should not exceed 24 months, with longer handset finance separated from airtime.

guard_streams.source: General Conditions that protect business customers

facts.detail: General Condition C1 requires at least one 12-month contract option for each relevant service.
C1 requires at least one month's notice of detrimental contract changes and a penalty-free exit option.
C1 requires end-of-contract and annual best-tariff notifications.
C2 requires providers to publish service descriptions, tariff information and standard contract conditions.
C3 requires accurate billing and adequate, up-to-date billing information for customers.

guard_streams.source: Latest telecoms and pay-TV complaints revealed - Q4 2025

facts.detail: Ofcom published the Q4 2025 provider-complaints update on 11 May 2026.
The figures cover October to December 2025.
Overall complaints increased from the previous quarter for the first time since 2023.
Broadband and landline complaints decreased, pay-TV complaints were unchanged and mobile complaints increased.
TalkTalk and Vodafone generated the most broadband complaints, while Plusnet and Virgin Media generated the fewest.

guard_streams.source: Latest telecoms and pay-TV complaints revealed - Q3 2025

facts.detail: Ofcom published the Q3 2025 provider-complaints update on 19 February 2026.
The Q3 2025 complaints page was last updated on 8 May 2026.
The figures cover July to September 2025.
Broadband, landline, mobile and pay-TV complaint levels were similar to the previous quarter.
EE, TalkTalk and Vodafone generated the most broadband complaints, while Plusnet generated the fewest.
